title: warnings.odin's per-packet node-slot scan duplicates core/topology.odin's node_slot helper
detail: The existing core helper implements the identical alive+id match; the new code hand-rolls it a third time (view.odin's bundle_strain_level scans too). All verified symbols exist and signatures match every call site, but this copy is redundant.
recommended_fix: Use node_slot(t, p.at_node) with an or_continue for the not-found case; delete the inline scan.

title: Unused import added to core/catalog_test.odin
detail: The r2 hunk adds import "core:fmt" to catalog_test.odin but the file contains no fmt.* usage (single grep hit is the import line itself). Dead import; Odin tolerates it but the lint gates may flag it.
recommended_fix: Remove the import "core:fmt" line from core/catalog_test.odin.
